Messages.Author: ulph
Messages.Body:
Hello! Upon browsing Amaranth, I notice Helena has the following card text, on the actual card as well as the "revised" tab:

"revised"

Name: Helena
[CE:V, BSC:X]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Toreador
Group: 3
Capacity: 10
Discipline: obf pre tha AUS CEL DOM
Camarilla: While Helena is locked and ready, she can burn 1 blood to wake, but only for reaction cards requiring Auspex [aus]. +1 bleed.
Artist: Rebecca Guay

---

"official"

Name: Helena
[CE:V, BSC:X]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Toreador
Group: 3
Capacity: 10
Discipline: obf pre tha AUS CEL DOM
Camarilla: If Helena is locked and ready, she can burn a blood to be able to attempt to block and/or play reaction cards that require Auspex [aus] as if unlocked for the remainder of the action. +1 bleed.
Artist: Rebecca Guay

---

What is this "revised" card text on Amaranth to begin with? Pending changes? Some unofficial rewording?

If pending official it is quite a significant nerf unless I misread - ie, cannot wake/block without playing a [aus] reaction card?

Messages.Author: Ke.
Messages.Body:
It helps to pick up and correct issues in forthcoming card text / revisions. The more eyes the better.

For example the revised text of Huitzilopochtli currently has a typo; this was reported by an Amaranth user; Vincent has been notified and can then correct the source file.

Messages.Author: TwoRazorReign
Messages.Body: Yeah, but the official wording on Amaranth is juxtaposed against unofficial card layouts. I'm therefore not sure why players would assume anything on Amaranth is official. I'd assume the opposite and that someone provided revised text and layouts for personal use.
